features.name: v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V1 to V2, capturing the relative proportion of these two continuous features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows tree models to split on the relative magnitude of V1 and V2 rather than just their absolute values.

features.name: v8_high_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for whether V8 is above its mean value of 37.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct binary split for tree models based on a significant threshold in V8.

features.name: v12_abs_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of V12 from its mean value of -0.19.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps tree models identify extreme values in V12 regardless of direction.

features.name: v30_log_transform
features.description: Logarithmic transformation of V30 to handle potential right-skewness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme outliers in V30, making splits more robust.

features.name: v3_v5_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between count features V3 and V5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures synergistic effects between V3 and V5 that a tree might otherwise need multiple splits to approximate.

features.name: v15_v39_diff
features.description: Difference between continuous features V15 and V39.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct measure of the gap between V15 and V39, useful if their relative difference is predictive.

features.name: v16_v23_max
features.description: Maximum value between count features V16 and V23.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights the dominant feature between V16 and V23 for each instance.

features.name: v31_bucketed
features.description: Ordinal bucketing of V31 into three categories based on thresholds 1.0 and 3.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups continuous values into discrete ordinal bins, simplifying the decision boundary for tree models.

features.name: v36_v37_sum
features.description: Sum of continuous features V36 and V37.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines the additive effect of V36 and V37 into a single feature.

features.name: v41_is_zero
features.description: Boolean indicator for whether V41 is exactly zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly flags the absence of the property measured by V41, which is often a strong signal in tree models.

features.name: molecular_complexity_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall molecular complexity based on the combination of count features like V3, V5, V6, and V7.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, non-linear evaluation of complexity that deterministic formulas might miss.

features.name: hydrophobicity_estimate_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of hydrophobicity based on continuous features like V1, V2, and V12.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes domain-specific intuition about chemical properties into a continuous score.
